research.title: Stabilized Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated a research question on unstable importance weights and led development of a weight clipping procedure for conformal regression.
Evaluated empirical coverage and interval width under simulated covariate shifts, comparing clipped weights with unweighted and standard importance weighted baselines.

research.title: Robust Regression with Contaminated Training Data
bullets: Investigated how residual contamination affects regularized regression and led development of an alternating residual weighting and coefficient estimation procedure.
Compared the procedure with Huber and squared loss regression across contamination patterns, examining prediction error and sensitivity to tuning choices.

research.title: Hierarchical Shrinkage for Groupwise Probability Calibration
bullets: Formulated a research question on calibration with sparse subgroup labels and led development of logistic calibrators with shared shrinkage penalties.
Designed held out evaluations comparing pooled, independent subgroup, and shrinkage calibrators using reliability diagrams, probabilistic losses, and subgroup sample size sensitivity.

publications.title: Shared Shrinkage for Logistic Probability Calibration in Small Subgroups

projects.title: Dimension Reduction for Correlated Regression Features
bullets: Implemented principal component regression and ridge regression in NumPy, using training fold transformations to prevent information leakage during cross validation.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, examining sensitivity to retained components and regularization strength.

projects.title: Approximate Kernel Classification
bullets: Implemented random Fourier feature mappings for Gaussian kernel approximation and integrated transformed features with regularized linear classifiers.
Compared approximate and exact kernel classifiers on predictive performance, runtime, and memory requirements while varying feature dimension and kernel bandwidth.

projects.title: Covariance Constraints in Gaussian Mixture Clustering
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal and full covariance matrices, including covariance regularization and multiple initialization strategies.
Compared clustering agreement and held out likelihood across overlapping synthetic distributions, examining sensitivity to initialization, covariance constraints, and component selection.
